## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to carry a [`gmeow:TimeZone`](../classes/gmeow-TimeZone.md)'s canonical IANA tzid string — the identifier libraries resolve to the full DST ruleset.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting two ids (it is functional — one tzid per zone) and avoid storing a fixed numeric offset here; the tzid, not an offset, names the zone's seasonal rules.

### How to use

- Write the IANA tzid as an [xsd:string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string) (America/Toronto, Europe/Paris, UTC); reference the [`gmeow:TimeZone`](../classes/gmeow-TimeZone.md) from the calendar/schedule/event time-zone edges.

### Examples

- ex:torontoZone [`gmeow:timeZoneIanaId`](gmeow-timeZoneIanaId.md) "America/Toronto".
